create_video_augmenter_by_resolution: create a VideoAugmenterByResolution instance with a positive float scale factor to resize video resolution
run_add_augmenter_resolution: run add_augmenter on a VideoAugmenterByResolution to resize a video file and save the output
run_get_command_resolution: run get_command on a VideoAugmenterByResolution to generate the FFMPEG CLI command list for resolution scaling
test_video_augmenter_by_resolution: test VideoAugmenterByResolution by passing a scale factor and verifying the generated FFMPEG scale and pad filters
refactor_video_augmenter_by_resolution: refactor VideoAugmenterByResolution to support separate horizontal and vertical resolution scale factors
